name: Apawcalypse: Gang War
description:
About This Game

The world has fallen. Animals have risen, and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, and lead your animal gang through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.

=== Customize Your Deck ===


Build your strategy from a wide variety of cards—Barracks, Farms, Tech, Brain, Traps, and more.

Command over 10 unique animal factions, each bringing their own playstyle and synergy to your deck

=== Build Your Hideout ===

Shape your path to survival.

Focus on economic growth, overwhelm enemies with sheer numbers, or invest in elite high-level units—every choice defines your strategy.

=== Choose Your Enemy ===
Every day, choose one of three enemies to face.

Adapt to the situation, plan ahead, win reward, and survive for 28 days to win the run.

=== Positioning Your Army ===
Scout enemy formations and deploy your units wisely.

Arrange melee, ranged, cavalry, siege, and flying units to create the perfect battle formation.

=== Discover New Card ===

Over 500+ Cards and 100+ Artifacts await discovery.

Unlock new cards through victory and expand your strategic possibilities with every successful run.

=== Survive the Apocalypse ===

Enemies become smarter everyday. Lead your gang through a harsh world where every decision matters.

One wrong move could end your run.
